an7.25:1.1: satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi
an7.25:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā
an7.25:1.4: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave bhikkhū saddhā bhavissanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.25:2.6: paññavanto bhavissanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.25:3.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
